pet_notes: One large yellow-orange upper-body character only. Preserve half-lidded blue-gray eyes, orange muzzle, top bun, ears, olive diagonal strap, exactly one round green-gray-pink pouch, and the flat source crop at the brown shorts. Exactly two arms/hands: the screen-left hand must always grip exactly one short gray stick holding the source mascot-shaped ice-cream/figurine (tiny orange capybara shape with bun, ears, face, brown shorts, pale strap and tiny pouch); the screen-right arm stays anatomically attached. The held item is one required prop, not an extra primary body: never omit, duplicate, detach, swap hands, or turn it into extra anatomy. Never add legs, feet, tail, torso below the crop, extra limbs/hands, a second large body, or any unrelated miniature.
